rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Payload {
    meta:
        description = "Detects encrypted Cobalt Strike beacon stages based on entropy and structure"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        malware_family = "CobaltStrike"
        severity = "critical"
    strings:
        $a = { 60 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 } // MZ stub
        $b = { E8 [0-255] 00 00 00 } // Call + relative offset
        $c = { 6A 00 68 [4] 64 A1 00 00 00 00 50 64 89 25 00 00 00 00 } // FS:[0] access (SEH)
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and 
        filesize < 1MB and 
        $a and $b and $c and 
        entropy(0, filesize) > 7.0
}
